coverageNotes: Partial MIDI coverage: only the listed addresses are established.
Select DIAL mode with DIAL MODE for dial MIDI output; FOCUS instead emulates mouse wheel/click (MIDI chart p.4, footnotes 1–2).
STRIP MODE toggles Mode 1/Mode 2; OCTAVE buttons switch pad pages 1–8 (p.4, footnotes 3–4).
Match the chart SHIFT, pad page and strip mode context to the selected mapping. Encoder-mode E1 channel conflict remains unresolved (p.1).
Still needed: Manufacturer correction for E1 unshifted note 16 and shifted note 17: decimal channel 1 versus hexadecimal 96/channel 7.
Still needed: Adapter support for source-specific 01/41 encoder motion, paired strip CCs and color-number feedback.
Still needed: Runtime support for poly-aftertouch; all 128 documented pressure rows retained as unsupported.
Still needed: Numeric RGB palette for color numbers, zero-value receive behavior where omitted, and encoder touch data2 semantics where blank are not established by the chart.
Still needed: Hardware validation and runnable application integration remain outside this extraction.

All four official MIDI chart pages processed, retaining transport, encoder, strip and 16-pad/eight-page rows including SHIFT and receive directions. E1 encoder-mode input/output addresses are quarantined for contradictory channels. Poly-aftertouch retained as unsupported. Source-specific relative values and ordered strip CC pairs remain explicit; no runtime integration.
Includes 765 documented control entries. See coverage limits for 4 source issues or areas still to be added.
Available controls let you look up Note and CC addresses. Lighting effects, encoder behavior and device setup still require the manufacturer instructions.

Choose the entry matching your control and its mode or condition. Selecting a profile mode does not change the hardware. Paired messages and other complex controls are available to read but cannot be assigned here.
A documented fixed channel takes priority. Otherwise the control uses your selected channel; confirm that it matches the device.
Choose the correct MIDI port on your device. Port restrictions are shown only where the manufacturer explicitly labels a port.
Channel 1 is only a UI starting value, not a claimed manufacturer default. Confirm the channel on your device before using entries without a fixed channel.

evidence.locator: PDF p.4, footnotes 1–4; p.1 encoder/strip rows; pp.2–4 pad rows

limitations.message:
Conflicting information: E1 unshifted note 16: decimal channel 1 conflicts with both status 96 bytes (channel 7). Both directions excluded; neither address interpretation selected.
Not included: E1 note 16 device-to-host; E1 note 16 host-to-device

Conflicting information: E1 shifted note 17: decimal channel 1 conflicts with both status 96 bytes (channel 7). Both directions excluded; neither address interpretation selected.
Not included: E1 note 17 device-to-host; E1 note 17 host-to-device
Not supported: All 128 explicitly addressed poly-aftertouch pad/page rows are retained but marked unsupported; these are pressure messages, not scalar note/CC controls.

Coverage limit: Dial/strip/page setup comes from footnotes 1–4. Relative 01/41 movement is not two’s-complement; ordered strip bytes and color-number feedback require adapters. Empty data2 details remain unknown.

Based on archived manufacturer documentation. The complete extraction metadata, original excluded chart rows and source files are retained in the manufacturer evidence archive. No hardware testing is claimed.
